subject: Renewal workshop: half-day roadmap + integrations — availability & attendees
messages:
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@enterprise-x.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Solis <diego@enterprise-x.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 12:02:00 -0700
Subject: Planning our renewal workshop (half-day)

Hiro —

Thanks again for the QBR last month. As we get closer to renewal, our Execs want a compact half‑day workshop that covers: roadmap priorities, integration checkpoints, and a lightweight ops run‑through (SLOs, logs, and a migration checklist).

High level asks:
- 3.5 hour session (AM preferred) with time for a 30m exec sync + 2 technical breakouts.
- Monica or an SE to cover the integration checklist you mentioned.
- An agenda and any prework at least 5 business days out.

Can you share availability the week of May 12? We’re in PDT (San Francisco).

Thanks,
Alice Nguyen
Head of Platform, Enterprise X

--
Alice Nguyen
Enterprise X
alice@enterprise-x.com
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@enterprise-x.com>
Cc: Diego Solis <diego@enterprise-x.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Apr 2025 16:45:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Planning our renewal workshop (half-day)

Hi Alice —

Appreciate the clarity. We can run a structured half‑day that hits exec + deep technical lanes. Quick answers up front:
- Week of May 12 — we have three AM options (PDT): Tue 5/13 9:00–12:30, Wed 5/14 9:30–13:00, Thu 5/15 8:30–12:00.
- Monica will lead the integration checklist and breakout. I’ve looped her in.
- I’ve attached a draft agenda and a short integration checklist for your review (renewal_workshop_agenda_v1.pdf, integration_checklist.xlsx).

Next steps I propose:
1) Pick the preferred date/time window from the three options.
2) Share attendee list and any internal constraints (exec duration, required stakeholders).
3) We’ll lock the agenda and circulate prework link (will publish to Drive).

If any of those AM slots don't work, tell me what days/times you prefer and we’ll adjust.

Thanks,
Hiro Tanaka
Account Executive — RedWood Inference
hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
From: Alice Nguyen <alice@enterprise-x.com>
To: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Solis <diego@enterprise-x.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Apr 2025 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning our renewal workshop (half-day)

Hiro —

Thanks for the options and the files — quick note on attendees: our execs can only do 30m, so we’ll need to compress that and shift more time to the breakout lanes. Also, can we avoid Wed the 14th — leadership travel.

Prefer Tue 5/13 9:00–12:30 PDT if you can compress the exec portion to 30m and confirm Monica can run the two technical breakouts (infra + integration).

Diego — attaching the internal invite list in case there are conflicts.

Best,
Alice
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@enterprise-x.com>, Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 16 Apr 2025 10:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Planning our renewal workshop (half-day)

On Tue, Apr 15, 2025 at 09:12 AM PDT, Alice Nguyen <alice@enterprise-x.com> wrote:
> Prefer Tue 5/13 9:00–12:30 PDT if you can compress the exec portion to 30m and confirm Monica can run the two technical breakouts (infra + integration).

Hi Alice —

I can run the integration breakout and will ask Aditya to join for the infra deep‑dive. We’ll adjust the agenda: 30m exec sync, 20m cross‑team prioritization, then two 45m technical lanes with a shared Q&A.

Attached: small edit to the agenda (renewal_workshop_agenda_v1.pdf — new version notes in the doc). I’ll prepare the integration checklist highlights as a one‑pager you can hand out.

Hiro — please go ahead and tentatively block Tue 2025‑05‑13 09:00–12:30 PDT; we’ll finalize once Alice confirms attendees.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Principal Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai
From: Hiro Tanaka <hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Nguyen <alice@enterprise-x.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Diego Solis <diego@enterprise-x.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 18 Apr 2025 09:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning our renewal workshop (half-day)

Alice —

Great — I’ve tentatively booked Tue, May 13, 2025 09:00–12:30 PDT on our side and sent a calendar hold to the external addresses you provided. Link to the shared Drive agenda and prework is here: https://drive.example/redwood/EnterpriseX/renewal_agenda_v1

Action items:
- Alice / Diego: confirm final attendee list by Wednesday 4/23 so we can publish the final agenda and prework.
- Monica / Aditya: prepare a 1‑pager integration checklist and an infra migrated checklist; deliver draft by 5/1.
- Hiro: create the run‑of‑show and share the HubSpot meeting record (deal EX-98231).

If attendee constraints change, we’ll shift to Thu 5/15 08:30–12:00 PDT as backup.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

Hiro Tanaka
Account Executive — Redwood Inference
hiro_tanaka@redwood.ai
